root_cause: Complete run inventory could be mistaken for exact candidate absence while an active dispatch title remains unresolved; missing identity fields and case-variant candidate titles can also escape both exact match and unresolved detection. A time-bounded main/workflow_dispatch provider inventory with contradictory nonempty metadata cannot prove completeness.
prevention_rule: Do not dispatch or infer exact verification when active main-indexed BRAIN run identity is unresolved; hold missing event/branch metadata and case-variant titles without inferring identity; reject any contradictory event/branch in a scoped history, even alongside an exact title.
